opt_smelt_desc: Smelt raw ores with coal into refined metal ingots.
opt_crush_desc: Break raw rocks to extract coal, metals, and rare gems.
opt_wash_desc: Wash raw gold nuggets into pure washed gold for higher yield.
opt_sell_desc: Sell mined minerals and smelted bars (%d items available).
opt_sell_all_desc: Sell every mineral, gem, and bar in your bag at once.
opt_shop_desc: Buy a heavy pickaxe for mining.
confirm_sell_all_body: Sell all mined items and smelted ingots in your bag for **$%.2f**?
pickaxe_broke: Your pickaxe broke from heavy wear!
washed_done: Washed %dx gold nuggets into %dx Washed Gold.
err_no_pickaxe: You need a Pickaxe to mine rocks.
err_cooldown: This vein is depleted. Try again in %d seconds.
err_no_materials: You do not have enough materials for that recipe.
err_no_rocks: You have no raw rocks to crush.
err_no_nuggets: You have no gold nuggets to wash.
err_bag_empty: You have no minerals or ingots to sell.
err_too_far: Move closer to the mining camp or ore node.
